gripOrHq.title: Karl de Veres, Corporate Stooge
gripOrHq.rulesText: Gain [1] after each successful run. Only one unique card of a particular name can be in play at a time. If for some reason more than one is in play, trash all but one.

gripOrHq.title: Inside Job
gripOrHq.rulesText: Make a run. You automatically pass the first piece of ice you encounter during that run.

heapOrArchives.title: Rush Hour
heapOrArchives.rulesText: Make a run on R&D. If run is successful, access three additional cards from R&D. You cannot use noisy icebreakers during the run.

heapOrArchives.title: Short-Term Contract
heapOrArchives.rulesText: Put [12] from the bank on Short-Term Contract when it is installed. When all the bits have been removed, trash Short-Term Contract. A: Take [2] from Short-Term Contract.

heapOrArchives.title: Temple Microcode Outlet
heapOrArchives.rulesText: Search your stack for a program. Show that program to the Corp, and then bring it into your hand. Shuffle your stack afterwards.

heapOrArchives.title: Rush Hour
heapOrArchives.rulesText: Make a run on R&D. If run is successful, access three additional cards from R&D. You cannot use noisy icebreakers during the run.

heapOrArchives.title: Open-Ended® Mileage Program
heapOrArchives.rulesText: Remove a tag, at no cost. You may pay [1] when you play Open-Ended® Mileage Program to take it back into your hand instead of trashing it.

heapOrArchives.title: Rush Hour
heapOrArchives.rulesText: Make a run on R&D. If run is successful, access three additional cards from R&D. You cannot use noisy icebreakers during the run.

heapOrArchives.title: Inside Job
heapOrArchives.rulesText: Make a run. You automatically pass the first piece of ice you encounter during that run.

heapOrArchives.title: Short-Term Contract
heapOrArchives.rulesText: Put [12] from the bank on Short-Term Contract when it is installed. When all the bits have been removed, trash Short-Term Contract. A: Take [2] from Short-Term Contract.

scoreArea.title: Project Zurich
scoreArea.rulesText: For every two advancement counters over Project Zurich 's difficulty that are on Project Zurich when you score it, gain 1 at the start of each of your turns.

scoreArea.title: Employee Empowerment
scoreArea.rulesText: You may choose to draw an additional card at the start of each of your turns. [A]: Draw two cards.

rig.title: HQ Interface
rig.rulesText: Whenever you access cards from HQ, access one additional card from HQ.

scoreArea.title: Employee Empowerment
scoreArea.rulesText: You may choose to draw an additional card at the start of each of your turns. [A]: Draw two cards.

ice.title: Credit Blocks
ice.rulesText: *End the run. When you rez Credit Blocks, you may pay [1], above the rez cost, to make it a wall instead of a sentry.

root.title: Virus Test Site
root.rulesText: You may advance Virus Test Site before and after you rez it. When Runner accesses Test Site, it does 2 Net damage per advancement counter on it, or 1 Net damage if it has no counters, even if it is not installed or rezzed. Ignore this effect if Runner accesses it from the Archives. If Test Site is accessed from R&D, Runner must show it to you.

ice.title: Misleading Access Menus
ice.rulesText: *End the run unless Runner pays [1]. Gain [3] when you rez Misleading Access Menus.
